changelog: Shared craft-common base: new optional argBase64Keys, jsonTextKeys and previewTools options (for DesignCraft); no change in this plugin's tools.
name: DeckCraft
description: Headless presentation editor (DeckCraft from ArtCraft, open source, written in Rust). Builds and edits slide decks with layouts, text, shapes, pictures, tables, charts, themes, transitions and animations; opens PPTX; saves PPTX and exports PDF and PNG slides.
instructions:
DeckCraft runs headless in your own container; every file lives in /work.

1. Upload the user's .pptx to /work and open it: open_presentation {"path":"/work/deck.pptx"} (only .pptx and .deckcraft; fonts missing in the container are listed as missingFonts and drawn with a substitute). Or start a new deck with new_presentation {"theme":"Harbor"}; run_command {"command":"design.themes","params":{}} lists the themes.
2. A new deck has one title slide: inspect_slide {"index":0} shows its placeholders, fill them with set_text {"id":...,"text":"..."}. Add slides with add_slide {"layout":"titleAndContent","title":"Pricing","body":"line 1\nline 2"} (one bullet per line). Slide indexes start at 0: the first slide is index 0, add_slide answers the index of the new slide. For more on a slide use add_text_box, add_shape, insert_table {"rows":3,"cols":2,"data":[[...]]}, insert_chart and insert_picture {"path":"/work/photo.png"} (always a path in /work, never data).
3. Everything else (themes, transitions, animations, speaker notes, SmartArt, sections…) is an engine command: list_commands {"filter":"transition"} — always pass a filter, never list all — then run_command {"command":...,"params":{...}}, or batch for several commands at once.
4. Check the result: inspect_document shows the slides and layouts; render_slide {"slide":0} saves a PNG of the slide into /work and returns its path (no inline image) — download it to look at it.
5. Save always with a path in /work, using new file names, never overwriting the user's input: save_presentation {"path":"/work/deck-edited.pptx"}, export {"format":"pdf","path":"/work/deck.pdf"}, export {"format":"png","all":true,"path":"/work/slide.png"} (writes slide1.png, slide2.png, …).
6. Hand the result over: download it from /work with plugin_download_file.

All paths must be inside /work; relative paths resolve against /work. Any text argument that starts with / or ../ (also the title and body of add_slide and the text of set_text) is checked as a file path and refused when it points outside /work, so rephrase such text (e.g. "etc folder" instead of "/etc"). A new MCP session (e.g. after a reconnect) starts with no open presentation, so save a .pptx after each stage and reopen it then. The container and /work are deleted after the conversation is idle, so always download the results.

accepts.description: PowerPoint presentation to edit or convert
Picture to place on a slide
Photo to place on a slide

returns.description: Slide exported or previewed as PNG
